```python
# filename: compute_increases.py
funds = [
    {"name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Index Fund", "ticker": "FPADX", "nav_2019_05": 10.80, "nav_2024_05": 12.45, "fee": "$0"},
    {"name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund", "ticker": "FEMKX", "nav_2019_05": 22.11, "nav_2024_05": 24.28, "fee": "$0"},
    {"name": "Fidelity Emerging Asia Fund", "ticker": "FSEAX", "nav_2019_05": 27.55, "nav_2024_05": 29.31, "fee": "$0"},
]

results = []
for f in funds:
    pct = ((f["nav_2024_05"] - f["nav_2019_05"]) / f["nav_2019_05"]) * 100
    results.append({**f, "pct_increase": pct})

# Print results
for r in results:
    print(f"{r['name']} ({r['ticker']}): May 2019 NAV={r['nav_2019_05']}, May 2024 NAV={r['nav_2024_05']}, Increase={r['pct_increase']:.2f}%")

# Identify lowest
lowest = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['pct_increase'])[0]
print("\nLowest increase:")
print(f"{lowest['name']} ({lowest['ticker']}) with {lowest['pct_increase']:.2f}%")
```
